[DINING] Green Tea Restaurant (绿茶餐厅) 3F | Haidilao (海底捞) 3F #311 | Cat Nip Community (猫薄荷社区猫咖) 2F | Soloist DownTown (单立人DownTown脱口秀) B1 — check show schedule

【餐饮】绿茶餐厅 3F | 海底捞 3F北311 | 猫薄荷社区猫咖 2F | 单立人DownTown B1脱口秀（查演出时间）

shopping.location_base: No. 269 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
shopping.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街269号
shopping.notes_base:
Rating 4.9/5 — highest-rated mall in Wangfujing. Timeline uses this slot for % Arabica coffee (3F East Tower, Kyoto-origin specialty coffee). While here, browse select stores. BUCKET LIST:

[DESIGNER / EMERGING BRANDS] Bosie (波西) — Chinese gender-fluid design brand, strong seasonal collections, concept-store aesthetic | JNBY (江南布衣) — Chinese independent designer, artistic wearable fashion | Sandro — French accessible luxury womenswear, knits and coats | Maje — French contemporary feminine pieces | Isabel Marant — French designer, Parisian-chic, iconic wedge sneakers | MM6 / Maison Margiela — avant-garde, Tabi split-toe shoes, OVA series

[KOREAN BRANDS] Gentle Monster — Korean luxury eyewear with art-installation boutique experience, oversized architectural frames. One of the top Korean brands to find. Verify if present in this mall.

[STREETWEAR] Palace Skateboards — UK skate brand, triangle-logo limited drops | Stone Island — Italian technical streetwear, compass badge sleeve patch

Note: Luxury mall, most items 1000+ CNY. Browse freely. Coffee at % Arabica is the primary reason to visit this slot.
shopping.notes_local:
评分4.9/5，王府井商圈评分最高。按时间表17:00在此喝%Arabica咖啡（3F东座，京都起源精品咖啡）。喝咖啡顺便逛逛。购物桶单：

【设计师/新锐品牌】波西（Bosie）中国无性别设计品牌，视觉强烈季节性系列 | 江南布衣（JNBY）中国独立设计师，艺术可穿戴风格 | Sandro 法国轻奢女装，针织和大衣 | Maje 法国当代女性风格 | Isabel Marant 法国设计师，巴黎休闲风，标志性楔形球鞋 | MM6/马吉拉 先锋时装，Tabi分趾鞋，OVA系列

【韩国品牌】Gentle Monster 韩国高端眼镜，艺术装置级店铺体验，超大建筑感镜框，最值得找的韩国品牌之一。确认是否在此mall有店。

【潮牌】Palace Skateboards 英国滑板品牌，三角logo限量款 | Stone Island 意大利技术街头服，罗盘徽章

注：高端购物中心，大多数单件1000元+，随意浏览。喝咖啡是本时段主要目的。

shopping.location_base: No. 253 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
shopping.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街253号
shopping.notes_base:
Rating 4.7/5. Beijing's most historic department store (founded 1955). Traditional department store format — not a trendy mall. Best for: beauty counters, jewelry, and the B1 gourmet supermarket. BUCKET LIST (pick what interests you):

[KOREAN BRANDS — BEAUTY] Sulwhasoo (雪花秀) 1F — Korean luxury skincare, ginseng First Care Activating Serum, Concentrated Ginseng Cream | Laneige (兰芝) 1F — Korean skincare, Lip Sleeping Mask (worldwide best-seller), Water Sleeping Mask | HERA 1F — Korean luxury makeup by Amorepacific, UV Mist Cushion foundation | Etude House (伊蒂之屋) 1F/B1 — Korean affordable makeup and skincare, fun packaging

[INTERNATIONAL BEAUTY] SK-II 1F — Japanese premium skincare, Facial Treatment Essence (神仙水) | Estee Lauder 1F — Advanced Night Repair, Double Wear Foundation | Clinique 1F — skincare staples

[ACCESSORIES / JEWELRY] IWC (万国表) 1F — Swiss luxury watches | Lukfook Jewellery (六福珠宝) 1F — HK gold and diamond jewelry | Ruan's Pearl (阮仕珍珠) 2F — premium Chinese freshwater pearl jewelry

[SPORT — North Wing] Nike North Wing 4F — full sport and lifestyle | Huawei 5F — tech accessories

[B1 SUPERMARKET — HIGHLY RECOMMENDED] Elite Supermarket (精选超市) — buy: Daoxiangcun (稻香村) pastries, Beijing specialty teas, baijiu miniatures, dried fruits. Budget 50-150 CNY, best travel souvenirs.

Open 09:30-22:00. All payment methods.
shopping.notes_local:
评分4.7/5。北京历史最悠久百货（1955年建），传统百货格局。最适合：美妆专柜、珠宝、B1超市。购物桶单（选你感兴趣的）：

【韩国品牌美妆】雪花秀（Sulwhasoo）1F 高端护肤人参系列，急救面膜 | 兰芝（Laneige）1F 唇睡眠面膜（全球爆款）、水酷睡眠面膜 | HERA 1F 爱茉莉旗下韩国高端美妆，气垫粉底 | 伊蒂之屋（Etude House）1F/B1 平价韩国彩妆护肤，包装可爱

【国际美妆】SK-II 1F 日本高端护肤，神仙水 | 雅诗兰黛 1F 小棕瓶精华、持久粉底液 | 倩碧 1F 护肤经典

【配饰/珠宝】万国表（IWC）1F 瑞士高端腕表 | 六福珠宝 1F 港资金饰钻石 | 阮仕珍珠 2F 高品质中国淡水珍珠

【运动-北馆】Nike 北馆4F 全系 | 华为 5F 科技配件

【B1超市-强烈推荐】精选超市——买：稻香村糕点、北京特产茶叶、白酒小瓶、干果，50-150元，最佳旅行纪念品。

营业时间09:30-22:00，各种支付方式均可。

shopping.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街256号
shopping.notes_base:
The iconic 1.8km pedestrian street — best enjoyed at night when the lights are on. Free. Evening stroll after dinner. BUCKET LIST — flagship stores along the street to pop into:

[STREETWEAR FLAGSHIPS] Anta × Palace Flagship (安踏PALACE旗舰店) No.247 — unique collaboration flagship, Anta x Palace Skateboards collab-exclusive pieces, must-see | Li-Ning Flagship (李宁旗舰店) No.249 — WADE basketball series, BADSTYLE, China seasonal collections | Nike — confirmed on strip | Adidas — confirmed on strip, check for China-exclusive colorways

[FAST FASHION] Zara No.241 — pedestrian street flagship store | H&M — along the strip

[KOREAN BRANDS] MLB — look for standalone store along or near the strip (brand expanding Beijing presence aggressively) | Gentle Monster — check if standalone boutique exists nearby

[SPECIALTY / HERITAGE] Shengxifu (盛锡福) — 100-year-old Beijing hat brand, unique souvenir under 200 CNY | Wangfujing Watch City (王府井钟表城) — watch browsing

[STREET FOOD] Wangfujing Snack Street (王府井小吃街) north end — scorpion skewers, Peking duck rolls, candied hawthorn (糖葫芦). Post-dinner snack walk.

Stores open 10:00-22:00. Street itself is 24 hours. Best shopping 19:30-21:00.
shopping.notes_local:
全长1.8公里王府井核心步行街，夜晚灯光效果尤佳，免费。晚饭后夜逛。购物桶单——沿街旗舰店：

【潮牌旗舰】安踏PALACE旗舰店 247号 安踏×Palace联名旗舰，独家联名款，必看 | 李宁旗舰店 249号 韦德系列/BADSTYLE/中国特色季节款 | Nike 沿街有店 | 阿迪达斯 沿街有店，留意中国限定配色

【快时尚】Zara 241号 步行街旗舰 | H&M 步行街段

【韩国品牌】MLB 寻找独立门店（北京快速扩张中）| Gentle Monster 确认附近是否有独立精品店

【特色/老字号】盛锡福 百年帽子老字号，200元内独特纪念品 | 王府井钟表城 腕表浏览

【街头美食】王府井小吃街 北端——蝎子串、北京鸭卷、糖葫芦，饭后消食散步。

各店10:00-22:00，步行街24小时，19:30-21:00购物黄金时段。

shopping.location_base: No. 88 Jinbao Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (Metro: Dengshikou Station Exit C, 340m walk)
shopping.location_local: 北京市东城区金宝街88号（地铁灯市口站C口步行340米）
shopping.notes_base:
Rating 4.7/5. Optional luxury detour — east of Wangfujing on Jinbao Street. If you have budget for serious luxury purchases, this is quieter and less touristy than the main strip. BUCKET LIST:

[LUXURY FASHION] Louis Vuitton (路易威登) — Speedy, Neverfull, Alma, Dauphine, Twist bags; Monogram accessories | Dior — Lady Dior, Saddle bag, Book Tote; women's RTW | Bottega Veneta (葆蝶家) — BV Jodie, Cassette, Arco; intrecciato woven leather, no logo | Loewe (罗意威) — Puzzle bag, Basket bag, Amazona; Spanish heritage luxury | Burberry (博柏利) — Nova Check trench coats, scarves, crossbody bags

[DESIGNER] Stella McCartney — sustainable luxury fashion, no leather or fur | AMI Paris — if not already visited at APM

[KOREAN — HIGH END] Gentle Monster — verify if present here or nearby; Korean luxury eyewear, the must-find brand

[BEAUTY — ULTRA PREMIUM] La Mer (海蓝之谜) — Creme de la Mer, Treatment Lotion, Concentrate | La Prairie (莱珀妮) — Skin Caviar Luxe Cream, the most premium skincare tier

Note: Most items 2000-20000 CNY. Visit only if budget allows. Open 10:00-22:00.
shopping.notes_local:
评分4.7/5。可选奢侈品专程，位于金宝街，比主步行街安静且游客少，服务更好。购物桶单：

【奢侈品时装】路易威登 Speedy/Neverfull/Alma/Dauphine/Twist包，Monogram配饰 | 迪奥（Dior）Lady Dior/Saddle/Book Tote包，女装成衣 | 葆蝶家（Bottega Veneta）BV Jodie/Cassette/Arco包，编织皮革无logo低调奢华 | 罗意威（Loewe）Puzzle/Basket/Amazona包，西班牙传统奢侈品 | 博柏利（Burberry）Nova格纹风衣、围巾、斜挎包

【设计师】Stella McCartney 可持续奢华，无皮革皮草 | AMI Paris 如在apm未买

【韩国高端】Gentle Monster 确认是否在此附近；韩国高端眼镜，最值得找的韩国品牌

【超高端美妆】海蓝之谜（La Mer）面霜、精华水、浓缩精华 | 莱珀妮（La Prairie）Skin Caviar系列，最顶端护肤品牌

注：大多数单件2000-20000元，有预算再来。营业时间10:00-22:00。

shopping.location_base: No. 301 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (Metro: Wangfujing Station Exit E1, 70m walk)
shopping.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街301号（地铁王府井站E1口步行70米）
shopping.notes_base:
Rating 4.8/5. Metro-adjacent option — directly next to Wangfujing Station Exit E1 (70m). Good as a quick first stop when arriving by metro, before the main mall circuit. BUCKET LIST:

[FAST FASHION] UR (Urban Revivo) — if present, same brand as at in88; skip if already visited | Uniqlo basics if not already covered

[KOREAN BEAUTY] The Face Shop (菲诗小铺) — Korean skincare chain, Rice Water Bright toner, Real Nature masks, good value | Etude House (伊蒂之屋) — Korean affordable makeup and skincare, fun packaging | Innisfree (悦诗风吟) — if present, Green Tea Seed Serum, volcanic pore series

[STREETWEAR] New Balance — check if present for sneaker browsing | Converse — classic basics

Note: Less premium than APM and in88. Best used as a quick metro entry browse, not primary destination. Skip entirely if time is tight — the other malls cover more preferred brands.
shopping.notes_local:
评分4.8/5。地铁紧邻站点，王府井站E1口步行70米。适合乘地铁到后顺路第一站快速浏览。购物桶单：

【快时尚】UR（Urban Revivo）如在场，与in88同品牌，去过可跳过 | 优衣库基础款如未买

【韩国美妆】菲诗小铺（The Face Shop）韩国护肤连锁，大米亮肤水、面膜，性价比好 | 伊蒂之屋（Etude House）平价韩国彩妆护肤，包装可爱 | 悦诗风吟（Innisfree）如在场，绿茶精华液、火山泥系列

【潮牌】New Balance 查楼层是否有球鞋 | 匡威（Converse）基础款

注：档次不如apm和in88，建议作为地铁入站顺路站，非主要目的地。时间紧可完全跳过，其他商场品牌覆盖更全。
